design: shared fixed 30-question set applied identically to all three companies AND all method variants (case reading: 每家公司同一已发布版本的30道评分题 — one published version; method comparison controls identical inputs across methods and companies)
mechanism: IQS select_questions(make_manifest) per default frozen profile (L02 precedent)
drop_rule: drop exactly one: largest numeric priority, tie -> id descending (frozen)
profiles_note: per-company profile manifests give 29 (CATL: operating|scaling|energy_transition, B2a growth) / 29 (CNCB: bank|mature|other, finance) / 31 (Alphabet: no B2a row; manual operating|mature) — none equals 30; the shared-set design (above) resolves this without profile gymnastics and is the stronger control for method comparison
